name: Entex Adventure Vision
description: A self-contained tabletop console from Entex, released in 1982, with its screen built into the unit. Instead of a CRT it used a single column of 40 red LEDs reflected off a spinning mirror to draw the image. It lasted about a year and only four games were made.
curiosities: All four games were arcade ports: Defender, Super Cobra, Turtles and Space Force.
Because of its moving mirror, many surviving units no longer work.
Nintendo's Virtual Boy later used a similar red-LED-and-mirror display technique.
story: Entex released the Adventure Vision in 1982, a tabletop console with a red LED display.
It had only a few games and a short life.
It is now one of the rarest consoles.
